title: French Toast
description: A classic breakfast dish originating from France, made by dipping bread in a mixture of eggs and milk, then cooking it in a pan.
instructions: 1. Crack the eggs into a shallow dish and whisk them together.
2. Add the milk and vanilla extract (if using) to the eggs and whisk until well combined.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
5. Place the bread slices in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
6. Repeat with the remaining bread slices.
7. Serve the French toast warm, topped with butter and your choice of toppings (such as maple syrup, fresh fruit, or powdered sugar).
